name: Nandan (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nandan town emblem in green: a swirl of three interlocking comma-shaped strokes.
history: Flag of the former town of Nandan in Hyōgo Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-01-11. The municipal emblem was adopted on 26 January 1956.

features.role: Nandan town emblem — a swirl of three interlocking comma-shaped strokes
